exclude_mission3: Original benchmark excludes it from algorithm comparison
state: All numeric Target=YES channels; hourly observed means, then daily mean and population SD
family: Published Subsystem metadata; both daily summaries retain the same family
context: All numeric Target=NO channels as daily means; four daily telecommand execution counts by Priority=0,1,2,3
categorical_channels: Excluded from numerical fluctuation states and numerical context
command_count: Count original event rows; no execution in a complete log interval is zero
resampling: Left-closed hourly bins, then daily; no interpolation or forward fill
state_feature_budget: Existing select_reference_channels, budget32, same rule across cohorts
clock: Published anonymized clock: time scaled by an undisclosed factor above 1; reported days are anonymized units
temporal_split_origin_rule: Training future_end_date precedes train_end; validation issue_time is at/after train_end and future_end precedes validation_end; test issue_time is at/after validation_end
endpoint: Existing HNE sustained multivariate fluctuation/displacement labels; original expert anomaly annotations remain a separate endpoint
primary_comparison: HNE source model frozen from RESILIENT+BrisT1D, compared with its history-only source model and DNB on each mission
secondary_comparison: Target-trained models use the same temporal train/validation boundaries and fixed HNE core

public_baselines.phase: target-domain training; separate from human-only source transfer

statistical_unit: Temporal blocks within each mission; report each mission separately, do not treat days as independent spacecraft
